m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: I hope you can forgive me for drafting you into this effort, but I believe this is the true path to proving my worthiness, and I need help.
My genes and a pile of Wurmling Scales may have satisfied the Binny Jezzerit, but how would I know if I truly merit the mantle of leadership?
No, let us navigate this labyrinth and confront the Great Wurm who still terrorizes these lands. If we fall, then such is my fate.
If the Legends are to be believed, the Great Wurm Melanj has inhabited these caverns for centuries. She is as smart as she is dangerous.
I wonder if that's what this strange inscription says. If only I had time to study it, but such is the burden of my destiny! Let's go.
This is the Great Wurm's Lair. Smart as she may be, ancient stories say Melanj cannot resist a specific series of sonic vibrations.
Some combination of using these Sand Thumpers will summon her. The trick is just figuring out what order in which to activate them.
I banish you, Wurm, from these sands and canyons. Into the Wastes you go, where no life persists. There, rumble away the remainder of your days.
All right, I must confess, I am feeling quite worthy now. I will return to Tabbi Manor and assert my claim. Meet me there.
Ah, so the traitor returns? Wizard, I'm disappointed. Instead of helping settle my claim, you bring someone back to challenge it?!
If there ever was a chance of me agreeing to an alliance with Aggrobah, there isn't any more. Your treachery has accomplished that much.
Things were once different, you know. In ancient times, Qhat heroes defeated the Great Wurms to prove themselves. But those days are long gone.
The Binny Jezzerit decreed that the Great Wurms were sacred, and started this tradition to collect Wurmling Scales instead.
Nowadays, the Great Wurm Melanj has free reign here. Indeed, we avoid these dunes for fear of the monster. It's embarrassing, really.
Hmm. Perhaps... yes. The Binny Jezzerit would never sanction it, but I would like to prove myself in the ancient way - I would defeat Melanj.
Indeed. Before I return to accept the lordship, I must do this, with your help. Venture into the Cavern of the Wurm with me. Come, this way.
